title: Publish European property-selected masks
changes: Publish authenticated e100 mask data and serve its bytes through the runtime while preserving original guest selector arithmetic and adjacent owners.
Update generation assertions and result counts in prior focused tests for the new resource.
validation: After correcting a missing test trait import, one isolated Windows build and focused Wine test passed: 89 previous files unchanged, full byte and mixed-edge checks, transactional tamper refusal, and six original native-prefix cases matching raw state and clock.
limitations: Updated prior focused tests were not individually rerun; their result-count-only corrections followed the focused test build. Production CLI, ordinary use, Linux, USA and native Windows remain unverified. No performance measurements.
